posts.cooked:
Hey folks it's me again with another thread , this time it's about the new game coming out next year . A user named WalkingTarget made a archetypes/equivalents for the  new characters , I just want to know if you agree or not . 

  • Bowman - archer with trick arrows - Green Arrow/Hawkeye

  • Captain Thunder - "leader" type, flight + strength + electricity powers, so I guess Legacy if based on was Captain Marvel instead of Superman?

  • Daedalus - the actual Daedalus from Greek myth - has invented an anti-gravity battle suit and is the team's inventor/technician type. Iron Man?

  • Dr. Metropolis - "Spirit of Cities" able to alter urban environments, so like if the Spectre was a civil engineer/city planner?

  • Johnny Rocket - speedster, so Tachyon/Flash/Quicksilver

  • Lady Liberty - powered by the "Light of Liberty" and has super strength, like many of these it's a legacy character with the "light" being passed from person to person. Wonder Woman/Captain America mashup?

  • Pseudo - shape-shifting alien telepath - Martian Manhunter

  • The Raven - stealthy crimefighter, Wraith/Batman

  • Siren - Voodoo loa of the sea - weather/sea powers so Storm/Tempest + Hydroman?

  • Star Knight - Space cop so I guess Nova/Green Lantern?

  • Argo the Ultimate Android - construct that can copy super powers, so Ultron+Super Skrull?

  • Hades - the actual Greek god, probably Deadalus' nemesis - works through intermediaries, so I'm imagining a minion heavy deck like Citizen Dawn or Grand Warlord Voss.

  • The Meta-Mind - hive-mind ruler of Pseudo's people, so maybe the Kree Supreme Intelligence?

  • Omega - seems to be some kind of cosmic big bad ruling some alternate dimension (Terminus). Darkseid/Thanos?

I disagree with all of them for obvous reasons , it's just one of the things that dont like about this fanbase . I wont rant or anything to not have people attack me or get this locked or both but I will say that it just screams ignorance to a degree .
